title: Progress Card System
description: A four-image reference-dependent set that locks one fitness progress-share language across achievements, streaks, PBs, and community challenges.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the share-card palette, celebratory geometry, and mobile-native progress language. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while adapting the same system to streaks, personal-best moments, and community challenge cards.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-streak-celebration-card, 03-personal-best-card, 04-community-challenge-card. Queue may run 02-streak-celebration-card, 03-personal-best-card, 04-community-challenge-card concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
